About Me

I’m a Civil Engineering student at Toronto Metropolitan University with a growing focus on structural engineering.

I’m passionate about structural engineering and sustainable infrastructure, with a strong work ethic and commitment to growth. I’m seeking a co-op opportunity to apply my technical skills, gain industry experience, and contribute to meaningful projects.

MULTIDISCIPLINARY DESIGN-BUILD · STRUCTURAL ENGINEERING

TimberFever 2026

A fast-paced timber design competition that brought architecture and engineering students together to turn a shared concept into a full-scale structure.

As one of three engineering students on a six-person team, I contributed structural thinking around stability and connections, cut timber components, and led the team through the assembly sequence.
